title: Generalizing from simulation
body: Our latest robotics techniques allow robot controllers, trained entirely in simulation and deployed on physical robots, to react to unplanned changes in the environment as they solve simple tasks. That is, we’ve used these techniques to build closed-loop systems rather than open-loop ones as before.
summaryZh: 本文来自OpenAI，围绕“Generalizing from simulation”介绍行业落地方面的最新进展，重点涉及行业应用。下方为系统保存的原文正文。
